home.tagline: Built in Alberta, for the world.
home.aboutMandate: Under Minister Glubish's mandate, Alberta has set a bold target: engage at least 25% of the public service and increase productivity by 25%. The Academy is how we get there, one cohort at a time.
home.skillsSubtitle: Technology will keep evolving. Platforms will come and go. Models will get faster, smarter, and more capable every few months. The Academy is designed around skills that hold their value through all of that change.
home.skillCommunicationBody: AI responds to how well you explain what you need. The people who get the best results are the ones who can describe a task precisely, set the right context, and define what success looks like. These are the same skills that make someone effective in a meeting, in a briefing note, or in a conversation with a colleague. The Academy sharpens them.
home.skillCuriosityBody: The difference between someone who finishes this program and sees AI as a minor convenience and someone who sees it as a way to rethink how their entire team operates comes down to one thing: the willingness to experiment and ask "what if."
home.skillsFooter: These are not technology skills. They are human skills, applied in a new context. And they will serve you regardless of which tools you are using a year from now.
home.diagramsSubtitle: Each level builds on the last. From writing a great prompt to designing autonomous AI systems.
home.closingBuiltTitle: Built in Alberta, for the World
home.title: Alberta AI Academy
home.subtitle: AI is already reshaping how organizations operate and how people do their best work. The Alberta AI Academy was created so that public servants are not on the sidelines of that shift. They are leading it.
home.aboutP1: The world is changing faster than any training program has ever had to keep up with. AI is already reshaping how organizations operate, how services are delivered, and how people do their best work. The Alberta AI Academy was created so that public servants are not on the sidelines of that shift. They are leading it.
home.aboutP2: The people who serve Albertans carry deep expertise. Years of experience in policy, operations, service delivery, project management, communications, and countless other disciplines. That expertise is irreplaceable. But the tools available to apply it have changed dramatically, and they will keep changing.
home.aboutP3: AI gives every public servant the ability to work faster, think through problems more thoroughly, and deliver higher quality results. But only if they know how to use it well. The Academy exists to close that gap. Not with theory, but with practical skills you can put to work the same week you learn them.
home.masterclassCardDesc: Deputy Minister Janak Alford walks through the full AI adoption framework in this AI masterclass.
home.videoKeynote: AI Academy Deputy Minister Alford Keynote
home.videoPlaybook: The Government of Alberta's AI Playbook
home.skillCriticalBody: AI can process enormous amounts of information, but it needs you to ask the right questions, evaluate what comes back, and know when something needs a closer look. Your judgment is what turns raw AI output into trustworthy, high-quality work.
home.level1Subtitle: Learn how AI works and how to use it well.
home.level2Subtitle: Build reusable skills. Scale excellence across teams.
home.level3Subtitle: Design AI systems that reason and act autonomously.
home.chooseLevelSub: Start where you are. Every level builds directly on the last.
home.personalPlanDesc: Not sure where to start? Our AI assistant will ask you a few questions about your role and learning goals, then generate a custom curriculum you can download as a Word document.
home.bubble1: Hi! Tell me about your role in government…
home.bubble2: I'm a policy analyst and I'm new to AI tools.
home.bubble3: Great! I'll build you a custom Level 1 + 2 curriculum.
home.closingDemandBody:
One of the clearest lessons from the past year is that as people become more productive with AI, the demand for their work increases. Time saved on routine tasks fills immediately with higher-value work: deeper analysis, better engagement with the people we serve, and tackling challenges that have waited years for the capacity to address them.

The Academy is an investment in you. In your growth, your adaptability, and your ability to lead through a period of change that is only accelerating.
home.closingBuiltBody:
Alberta is recognized as a leader in public service AI adoption. The tools, curricula, and lessons coming out of this program are being shared with partners across Canada. What you learn here contributes to something larger than any single ministry or province.

Be patient with yourself. Be curious. Experiment. And bring what you learn back to your teams. Welcome to the Academy.
home.level1Desc:
This is where everyone starts. You will learn how AI works in plain terms, why it behaves differently from the software you have used before, and how to write clear instructions that produce reliable, high-quality results. You will get hands-on experience with the platforms available to you: Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, and Albert, a custom-built AI platform developed right here in Alberta.

You will learn to use AI as a thinking partner, not a search engine. Instead of asking it for facts, you will learn to bring your own knowledge and engage in a back-and-forth that makes your work sharper, more thorough, and more creative. You will also learn to recognize low-quality AI output and understand why the quality of what you put in determines the quality of what you get back.
home.level2Desc:
Level 2 takes you from using AI to building with it. The big idea here is reusable skills: small, shareable files that capture your team's best thinking so that anyone can apply the same standard of quality. Your best writer's structure, your best analyst's reasoning, your best project lead's planning approach, all written down in a format that AI can use as a guide.

This is how excellence scales. Instead of training every person to the same level in every discipline, you make the best practices from across the organization available to everyone.

You will also learn to design workflows that chain multiple AI steps together, integrate purpose-built tools like Pronghorn, and build processes that run reliably and repeatably. This is where individual productivity gains turn into team-wide and ministry-wide impact.
home.level3Desc:
Level 3 is about designing AI systems that can reason through complex, multi-step problems with minimal hand-holding. These are called agents, and they represent the frontier of what AI can do for public service delivery.

At this level, you will learn to build workflows that select the right tools, execute a sequence of tasks, and deliver results that would have taken a team of people days or weeks to produce. You will also learn the governance side: how to keep human oversight in place for important decisions, how to make AI work auditable and transparent, and how to build systems that learn and improve from real outcomes.

This is where the biggest opportunities live. Faster service to Albertans. Fewer bottlenecks. Better use of the expertise and experience that public servants already bring to their work every day.
